drhp.business: The Company undertakes cross-country pipeline projects, city gas distribution networks, storage terminals, and operations & maintenance services for leading energy companies in India. It provides engineering, construction, and maintenance services for the Oil and Gas industry, spanning the complete project lifecycle from pipeline construction to associated facilities.
drhp.expansion: LIL continued expansion into India, Abu Dhabi, and Saudi Arabia during FY 2025-26. drhp.one_liner: Likhitha Infrastructure Limited is an Oil and Gas Infrastructure Company with 28 years of experience in pipeline construction and associated facilities.

City Gas Distribution: Steel and MDPE pipeline laying, distribution infrastructure, last-mile connectivity, CNG station construction
Cross-Country Pipelines: Pipeline laying, mechanical works, civil construction, electrical and instrumentation systems, testing, commissioning for crude oil, natural gas, LPG, and petroleum products
Operations & Maintenance: Manpower support, preventive maintenance, emergency response, repairs, routine operational activities
Storage Solutions & Terminals: Storage tanks, loading facilities, pump houses, mechanical piping, civil works, electrical systems, instrumentation, fire & gas detection systems
